title: Hieu Duong
text:
05/2023 – Present: AI Engineer, FPT Smart Cloud

Developed Large Language Models (LLMs) and core engines for AI Agents in real-world applications (chatbot systems and recommendation systems).

10/2021 – 05/2023: AI Engineer, Innovation Center - VNPT-AI

Developed information retrieval models for Vietnamese chatbots.
Conducted research on intent classification and slot filling for Vietnamese chatbots.






2017 – 2022: B.Sc. in Engineering, Posts and Telecommunications Institute of Technology (PTIT) — Hanoi, Vietnam

Major: Information Technology
Supervisor: Dr. Ngo Xuan Bach (Associate Professor), Vice Dean, Faculty of Information Technology (homepage)
Thesis Title: Intent Detection and Slot Filling for Vietnamese Chatbots
GPA: 3.3/4.0
Thesis defense score: 9.6/10.0






🥉 10/2025: 3rd prize in Vietnamese Legal Document Retrieval Competition at VLSP 2025

Our solution demonstrates high efficiency and effectiveness for Vietnamese legal document retrieval.

🥈 08/2025: 2nd prize in FPT Smart Cloud AI Hackathon 2025 (AIVerse Hackathon)

Built an AI Agent System for document analysis and reporting.

🥇 08/2024: Champion in FPT Smart Cloud AI Hackathon 2024 (We Are Hackathon)

Built a Hybrid Labeling Platform powered by LLMs.

🥈 2023: 2nd prize in VNPT.AI Hackathon 2023

Built an employee behavior analysis and reporting system.

🥇 2020: 1st prize in ACM ICPC – PTIT 2020, Issued by Posts and Telecommunications Institute of Technology
🥇 2018: 1st prize in MATH OLYMPIAD FOR STUDENTS 2018, Issued by Vietnam Mathematical Society, Vietnam Unions Of Science And Technology Associations

title: About
text: Hello ! My name is Hieu Duong (Dương Xuân Hiếu in Vietnamese). I’m an AI Engineer at FPT Smart Cloud. My current work focuses on research and development of Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI Agents for real-world applications, such as chatbot systems and recommendation systems. I also conduct research in various fields related to Natural Language Processing (NLP), with a particular focus on Vietnamese (my mother tongue) and English. My research interests include Information Retrieval and Retrieval-Augmented Language Models. In addition to my professional work, I enjoy reading and writing blogs about life experiences and personal reflections.
